setting.label: Base Domain URL
setting.help: Base domain URL for the streaming website. Change if the site moves to a new mirror.

setting.label: Desktop User-Agent
setting.help: Spoofed browser User-Agent header for HTTP requests.
setting.default: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

setting.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
setting.help: Maximum seconds to wait for network responses before aborting.

setting.label: Verify SSL Certificates
setting.help: Disable if encountering SSL certificate or handshake errors on mirror domains.

setting.label: Bypass ISP DNS Blocking (DoH)
setting.help: Automatically bypasses ISP-level DNS blocks and redirects using Google DNS-over-HTTPS.

setting.label: Auto-select First Working Server
setting.help: Automatically resolves and plays the first working stream without showing the server selection dialog.
